assumptions.statement: 三个重点区的精确 official polygons 当前未进入本轮证据包；现有 provisional context 只支持关系研究，公共地图锚点不得重新定义边界。
missing_evidence: 经清权的官方 CAD/GIS/PDF 边界附件
坐标系、版本、发布日期与来源哈希
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Research organization, relational design, figure location, and known low-confidence participant design-model metrics derived from explicitly provisional submitted geometry; not official or statutory claims.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得称为 official redline，不得据此确定道路、地块、建筑、拆改留或精确面积。
assumptions.impact: Provisional participant-design geometry may support known low-confidence design-model outputs for formal review. Official redlines, statutory controls, and official quantities remain unresolved; all boundary-sensitive metrics must be recalculated after cleared official geometry arrives.
resolution_path: 取得官方 polygon 或清权附件
在 sources.json 登记来源、版本、坐标系与哈希
替换 provisional geometry
重新运行 spatial review 并复算 metrics
同步复核 proposal、figures、HTML、PDF 与 manifest hashes
assumptions.metric_scope_note: Known provisional design-model metrics do not resolve the official-boundary evidence gap and must not be presented as official planning controls.

assumptions.statement: 总建筑规模、FAR、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率、退线和建筑控制线均缺少可用于本方案的正式控制依据。
missing_evidence: 有效控规及相关审批附件
正式地块边界、道路红线和控制线
可追溯的现状与规划指标表
assumptions.current_allowed_use: 只可讨论普通城市功能保留、界面关系、受控门槛和候选适应性。
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得给出法定 FAR、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率、退线、总建筑面积或审批结论。
assumptions.impact: 第7章和第11章只能登记 unknown controls、公开约值、provisional-computed site area 与复算方法；Phase 17 metrics 不构成 V0.2 法定或实施指标。
resolution_path: 取得并登记官方控规和控制附件
由专业团队核对适用版本与地块对应关系
把允许使用的控制值录入 metrics.json
复算并交叉检查 geometry、compliance 和图纸

assumptions.statement: 候选建筑的 exact floor use、retrofit permission、ownership、lease、fire safety 与 utility capacity 尚未核实。 这也包括公共边缘、受控房间、设备 bay 与地标候选的 exact host、权利、消防和适应性。
missing_evidence: 逐栋现状测绘与楼层使用资料
权属、租约与运营许可
消防、结构、荷载、供电和网络条件
assumptions.current_allowed_use: 只可把 public edge、visible work、controlled threshold 和 candidate adaptation 作为调查框架。
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得指定某房间、某首层、某建筑可改造，也不得承诺安装设备或改变用途。
assumptions.impact: 三种首层剖面是关系性 study，不是具体建筑设计或改造许可。
resolution_path: 建立逐栋现场与权属台账
核对消防、结构、设备和无障碍条件
取得业主与运营方可验证授权
由专业团队判断可适应范围并更新图纸

assumptions.statement: 维修、装卸、设备交接、故障隔离、充电或换电、备件、工具、值守与撤场所需的具体后场位置均未确认。 任何维护、隔离、恢复、替换、数据删除和场地修复能力都不得被预设。
missing_evidence: 设备规格和维护手册
运营、物业和供应商责任分工
装卸、消防、供电、储物和回收条件
assumptions.current_allowed_use: 只确认城市设计必须回答前场—后场—人工接管—退出的关系，不确认已有任何对应空间。
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得声称现有维修中心、机器人回收点、充电站、仓库、测试区或服务后场已经可用。
assumptions.impact: 后场只能作为 Candidate need；未闭合责任与空间链之前，不进入长期公共部署。
resolution_path: 按具体设备建立责任和故障清单
现场核查装卸、隔离、充电、储物和撤出条件
由运营/物业/供应商确认 SLA 与人工接管
仅在证据成立后定位并更新空间方案

assumptions.statement: 大钟寺商户、物业和运营方是否愿意参与 optional AI 试点，以及由谁承担安装、培训、维护、投诉和撤场劳动，当前未知。
missing_evidence: 商户与物业访谈或书面意向
责任、成本、数据和退出协议
普通经营不受影响的运营验证
assumptions.current_allowed_use: 只可表达普通商业/文化/交通网络完整、AI 为可绕行支路的设计底线。
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得把商户、员工、物业或顾客写成已同意参与者，也不得把 AI 设为经营或服务必经节点。
assumptions.impact: 大钟寺 optional AI 仍为 Candidate，不构成部署或合作计划。
resolution_path: 开展自愿、可撤回的商户与运营方访谈
记录额外劳动、成本与失败责任
形成普通服务保留和退出协议
仅对明确同意且条件成立的微型接口继续深化

assumptions.statement: 居民、访客、老年人、残障人士、陪同者和服务劳动者是否愿意参加 AI 试验或使用数字服务，不能预设。 自愿参与、补偿/工作量、代表性、隐私与退出条件仍需独立核验。
missing_evidence: 分人群现场观察与参与式调研
无障碍、门禁、开放时间与人工服务核查
告知、同意、投诉和退出机制
assumptions.current_allowed_use: 以 ordinary route、实体信息、人工服务、无障碍和非数字路径为优先设计约束。
assumptions.prohibited_claim: 不得把公共通行自动转化为训练、测试、数据采集或强制数字服务，也不得假设居民会参与。
assumptions.impact: AI-free path 必须连续；任何 AI 层都应可绕行、可关闭、可撤出。
resolution_path: 现场核查不同人群的普通服务路径
开展可撤回的公众参与与无障碍评估
验证人工和非数字替代是否独立可用
根据反馈保留、调整或退出候选试点

assumptions.statement: Future accountable actor classes could be assigned for operation, maintenance, data/content, safety, accessibility and public review.
missing_evidence: Named organisations, mandates, staffing, SLA, conflicts, budgets and agreements.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Design a responsibility interface and screen-out incomplete candidates.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: A government, university, company, merchant or community organisation has accepted a role.
assumptions.impact: No candidate may open or scale; operation remains a mechanism proposal.
resolution_path: Stakeholder process, written role/authority/capacity review and project-specific agreement.

assumptions.statement: The eight task-based personas expose relevant ordinary-city, AI, failure and service needs.
missing_evidence: Voluntary local research with actual diverse users/workers and evidence of frequency/priority.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: These are surveyed residents, representative demographics, demand forecasts or interview findings.
assumptions.impact: Needs and priorities may change after engagement.
resolution_path: Accessible, voluntary and privacy-respecting engagement
publish methods, limitations and dissent.

assumptions.statement: Selected global mechanisms can generate useful questions for Jingzhang.
missing_evidence: Comparative legal, institutional, land, data, funding and operational fit for Beijing/Haidian.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Derive testable design principles and transfer warnings.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: A global case proves that Beijing must or can build the same system.
assumptions.impact: Cases remain research references, not implementation precedents.
resolution_path: Local professional/institutional review and bounded pilots under applicable rules.

assumptions.statement: Some candidate tasks may receive meaningful value from AI after ordinary and human baselines are established.
missing_evidence: Task-specific data legality/quality, model capability, accessibility, error distribution and comparative baseline.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Define optional AI hypotheses and failure tests.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: AI is necessary, mature, accurate or available for any candidate.
assumptions.impact: Candidates may be implemented without AI or rejected if value is not demonstrated.
resolution_path: Offline/shadow-mode evaluation against a human/ordinary baseline, domain and accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: A continuous ordinary and AI-free path can be designed or protected for future candidates.
missing_evidence: Field-verified entrances, gradients, surfaces, crossings, barriers, hours, crowding and service routes.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Use continuity as a non-negotiable design gate.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Any current route is continuous, step-free, public or accessible.
assumptions.impact: Exact spatial layout and public opening are blocked until field/professional verification.
resolution_path: Multi-time field audit with diverse users and relevant professionals/authorities.

assumptions.statement: The three naming territories are sufficiently distinct for concept review.
missing_evidence: Comprehensive trademark, domain, bilingual linguistic, political/cultural and public-recognition screening.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Compare identity direction and communication fit.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Any name is legally available, approved or final.
resolution_path: Human selection, legal/trademark search, bilingual/public-language test and rights review.

assumptions.statement: A recurring open-evidence cycle could support long-term learning better than isolated showcases.
missing_evidence: Organiser, calendar, venue, budget, procurement, audience, safety and archive custody.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Design an operational mechanism and evidence outputs.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: An event is scheduled, funded, sponsored or government-backed.
assumptions.impact: Annual system is a candidate framework only.
resolution_path: Operator/venue feasibility, resource plan, public-value and accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: Some approved concept candidates may later receive defensible spatial geometry.
missing_evidence: Official/cleared project/site extents, CRS, rights, exact host and professional design review.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Define migration gates and non-geometric design sequencing.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: OSM points, provisional polygons or narrative imply a project point/corridor/polygon.
assumptions.impact: Current OSM helpers should exit future phasing; an empty layer may remain correct.
resolution_path: Human project shortlist then authoritative spatial evidence and full downstream recalculation.

assumptions.statement: A reversible public interface could become memorable without monumental construction.
missing_evidence: Exact site, heritage/public-space permission, structural/material/accessibility/maintenance design and asset rights.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Compare public value and AI-off functions.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: A landmark is approved, buildable, located, dimensioned or rights-cleared.
resolution_path: Heritage/site/operator/accessibility/rights review followed by professional design.

assumptions.statement: Future test protocols can establish appropriate success/failure thresholds.
missing_evidence: Specific technology, baseline, hazard analysis, domain standards, user needs and measurement/privacy cost.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Define categories of evidence and mandatory failure/recovery tests.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: A numeric threshold, certification criterion or technology readiness level has been established.
assumptions.impact: No industrial test can pass or scale from this framework alone.
resolution_path: Project-specific professional protocol, pre-registration where appropriate and independent/domain review.

assumptions.statement: The three-layer culture framework can integrate history, innovation work and accountable AI without distortion.
missing_evidence: Detailed heritage source review, exact artifacts/sites, interpretive authority, rights and public-language testing.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Set narrative hierarchy and prohibited metaphors.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Any unstated historical fact, official interpretation or approved heritage intervention.
assumptions.impact: Only existing verified formal-source facts may migrate; uncertain content remains absent.
resolution_path: Historian/heritage/institutional and rights review with source-level corrections.

assumptions.statement: A human-reviewed bilingual evidence passport can support international exchange.
missing_evidence: Audience, partner, translation workflow, accessibility, archive platform, rights and follow-up owner.
assumptions.current_allowed_use: Design communication fields and review pathway.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: International partnership, investment, audience reach or conversion effect.
assumptions.impact: Communication remains a candidate public-knowledge mechanism.
resolution_path: Human translation/editorial review, rights/accessibility checks and accountable host.
